sophia: quick sync  10m  velocity drip for benchmark + webinar plan. main goals: RSVP lift, high-quality demo requests, and benchmark downloads.
drew: propose a short 3-email mini-drip for warm leads and a longer 5-email for cold lists. mini: announce -> invite -> last-chance. longer: announce -> webinar invite -> use-case -> benchmark download -> final nudge.
oscar: segmentation: Warm (api_active last 30d), Interest (clicked product pages), Cold (newsletter only). exclude unsub/gdpr/do-not-contact.
mila: creative ops: hero images: engineer dashboard (variant A) vs savings chart (variant B). I can output both sizes (1200x628 and 600x300) by Wed AM.
aj: deliverability ops: send pool = SendGrid "bench-velocity-1". confirm IP warmness and throttle: warm lists 1k/min, cold 600/min. enable dynamic suppression to avoid duplicates.
drew: testing: for warm run subject A/B + first-line personalization test, sample 4k per cell. for cold run subject A vs control only. track with utm_campaign=bench_vel_may and utm_content=warmA/B/cold_ctl.
oscar: content personalization: use {{product_interest}} merge; for trial users include first-line: "Noticed you've been using the API  here's how others cut per-token cost." A/B test vs generic.
mila: CTA flow: primary CTA to register; post-reg send benchmark link + calendar invite. If demo clicked, route to AE with lead score tag.
aj: infra: retry policy for ESP 5xx: exponential backoff, max retries 5. set per-recipient daily cap = 2 sends for campaign to avoid fatigue. prefix suppression in ESP to dedupe same-day.
deliver-bot: ESP health: "bench-velocity-1" pool warmness 81%. projected full warm in 36h.
oscar: schedule: warm -> Tue 9am PT, interest -> Wed 10am PT, cold -> Thu 11am PT. countdown reminders: 5d, 2d, 2hr before webinar for registrants.
drew: copy notes: keep subject lines <60 chars, preheaders <100. test matrix: 2 subjects x 2 preheaders for warm.
mila: assets path: /marketing/assets/bench_velocity/ — will upload PNG + webp.
aj: QA plan: internal seeds to sophia, drew, aj, mila + 5 external test accounts. audience QA Wed AM.
sophia: approvals: product (aj), legal (legal@redwood.ai), deliverability (aj). need sign-off Thu EOD to hit Tue send.
drew: any blockers?
oscar: need final audience export from Data by Wed noon.
mila: none.
sophia: ok reconvene Thu after sign-off. thanks all :rocket:
